key_insight: Group-mean baseline subtraction drives RL’s LoRA updates toward spectral concentration and faster subspace rotation, unlike SFT’s spectral expansion at moderate learning rates.
engineering_relevance: Stage-specific LoRA updates can improve mathematical reasoning by spreading adaptation across singular directions in SFT and promoting subspace rotation in RL.
method: Track LoRA singular spectra and subspaces during SFT and RL.
Isolate baseline subtraction through controlled SFT-to-RL interpolation and a quadratic multi-index model.
Flatten the full update spectrum in SFT; flatten the update component outside the current LoRA increment span in RL.
evidence_signal: Across multiple models on mathematical reasoning tasks, the stage-specific configurations perform best among compared methods in most evaluated settings.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical gains or computational overhead, and generalization beyond mathematical reasoning remains unestablished.
paper_title: Spectral and Subspace Dynamics of LoRA in Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning
